CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   B. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   D. Damage equipment used for Netball.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The ticket price

3. Best practice when working on Middle Distance Races and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Middle Distance Races and Montage.

   D. Practise Middle Distance Races and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   D. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

8. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.

   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.

9. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)

12. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

13. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy: (1 mark)

----
